name: Filo pastry
description: Paper-thin unleavened sheets brushed with fat and stacked — the shell of baklava.

tcm.note: Unleavened wheat sheets; read with wheat.

ayurveda.note: Follows wheat; unleavened, so lighter than risen breads.

unani.note: Garam like gehun, and always cooked in fat.

histamine.note: Low — unleavened, unlike most bakery wheat.
